free_text_notes.physician_note: 61-year-old woman with hypothyroidism, obesity, admitted 5/24 for left total hip arthroplasty. Post-op day 4; working with PT twice daily. A low-grade temperature of 37.6 degrees was recorded on day 1. It resolved by day 2 without any treatment and has not returned.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. Bedroom is upstairs at home; setup not reviewed yet.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with nephew. 5/28 18:00: Metoprolol tartrate changed from 25 mg twice daily to 12.5 mg twice daily on evening rounds. Patient and nephew not yet told; this afternoon's teaching covered the old dose. Discharge paperwork still waiting on the summary. Earlier pickup was cancelled and rebooked for 14:30 to match the discharge time. Patient asked to move the orthopedic surgery clinic appointment; rebooked within 14 days of discharge.
